title: NCAA: Letran hands San Sebastian 37-point beatdown to stay perfect
summary: Colegio de San Juan de Letran dismantled San Sebastian College, 99-62, to stay perfect in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Friday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
